decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate builds directly on the firm's agricultural crate and injection-moulding know-how, so despite the lack of website visibility in 2020-2021 the firm can still read harvest-season feedback and refine the design in-house.
Foldable large containers sit at the core of the firm's automotive and industrial competence, where its accumulated knowledge lets it assimilate customer feedback and keep improving the line.

The spill-retention pallet is a niche safety product with weaker links to the core logistics knowledge and no visibility since 2019, but it still uses related pallet-moulding know-how, so the firm keeps it for now while watching it more closely.
